availability.legal_sourcing_notes: Great Basin National Park Superintendent's Compendium prohibits burning, gathering, possessing, collecting, or using Bristlecone Pine wood in any form within or from the park.
availability.market_notes: Treat actual ancient bristlecone as unavailable unless a separate legal provenance record proves otherwise.

fabrication_notes: Reference-only material. No fabrication use is authorized by this record.
Use this record as an endurance comparison target, not as a cut-stock material specification.
FIA biomass source lists Great Basin bristlecone pine with specific gravity 0.43 and wood density 26.83 lb/ft3. The kg/m3 value is a unit conversion of that listed density.
